page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Storage must be provisioned externally via network-attached block storage. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance provides a memory-dense profile for workloads that require more memory capacity than raw compute power. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for lightweight databases, caching layers, and memory-sensitive application runtimes that do not require high-frequency multi-threaded CPU processing or local disk I/O.

The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Lacking integrated graphics or local NVMe drives, this server is designed for workloads such as small-scale databases, in-memory caching, and lightweight application servers where memory capacity is prioritized over raw processing power or local disk performance.
